content.text: Waking now and then is common at 8, and summer's later bedtimes and looser routines often set it off again. Tonight, try a calm, boring script for when she wakes. Keep the lights low and don't chat. Walk her back to bed with the same one-line reassurance every time, like "You're safe, it's still night, back to sleep." If worries are keeping her up, a few minutes of talking them through before bed can help. A steady wake-up time, even on weekends, helps too.
